mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals a shift toward monetary easing, lowering discount rates and increasing present-value of future equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
